title: ManhuntButItWorks
description: A reliable Manhunt compass tracker for Paper with persistent targets, Nether portal fallback, and a global countdown timer.
body:
# ManhuntButItWorks

A Paper plugin for Minecraft Manhunt games. Hunters get a compass that cycles through online players, follows targets in the same dimension, and points toward the relevant Nether portal when direct tracking is not possible.

## Features

- Main-hand and off-hand target cycling
- Tracking that survives reconnects, restarts, deaths, and offline targets
- Persistent Nether portal fallback for cross-dimension tracking
- Protected compasses that cannot be dropped, stored, cloned, or bundled accidentally
- Server-wide countdown timer with cancel support

## Requirements

- Paper 1.21 or newer
- Java 21 for Paper 1.21 through 1.21.11
- Java 25 for Paper 26.1 and newer

## Commands

- `/manhuntcompass [player]` gives a tracking compass
- `/removecompass` removes your Manhunt compasses
- `/timer <seconds|cancel>` starts or stops the countdown
- `/manhunthelp` shows command help

Put the jar in the server's `plugins` folder and restart the server. No client mod is required.
